title: Finite information loss, channel capacity and exact reversibility
description:
Reversibility is exactly singleton predecessor fibres. Downstream maps cannot reopen closed source distinctions. Finite channel capacity retains every greatest zero-error code.

Maria Smith develops complete distinction ledgers, predecessor recovery, exhaustive code enumeration, tied maximum families, exact relational composition and arbitrary finite successor proofs in Smithian Fold Theory. The paper includes the mathematical arguments and pinned V3/V4 correspondence, 339 distinct empty-axiom audited declarations, two complete1024-form grammars and portable exact-output reproduction.
